#### dirichletPlate (elastodynamics)

The same manufactured elastodynamics problem as
`elastodynamics/vectorLBM/periodicPlate`, but on a non-periodic plate whose
whole boundary is prescribed with
`ElastodynamicsVectorLBMDirichletValidation`. The displacement of the
manufactured solution is imposed on the boundary cells, which are collected in
material number 2, and the resulting error shows how much accuracy the
Dirichlet treatment costs compared to the periodic case.

The `run.sh` script performs the same resolution sweep and order of convergence
study as `elastodynamics/vectorLBM/periodicPlate`.
